title: First flights: which country?
intro: Pick the country for each first flight, as recorded on Wikidata.

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Dragon?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives United States of America as the country of Dragon (8 December 2010).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Yakovlev SJ-100?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Russian Federation as the country of Yakovlev SJ-100 (19 May 2008).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Long March 5?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives China as the country of Long March 5 (3 November 2016).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Delta II?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives United States of America as the country of Delta II (14 February 1989).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Ariane 6?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives France as the country of Ariane 6 (9 July 2024).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Saab 2000?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Sweden as the country of Saab 2000 (26 March 1992).
